summary: Verified the new WooCommerce-style admin CRUD + image upload end-to-end. Backend: 14 passed + 1 skipped (no orders) in new /app/backend/tests/test_admin_crud.py — covers AuthZ (401 no token, 403 customer) on POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/products and POST /api/admin/upload, image upload with /api/static re-serve, Create→GET, Update→GET, Delete→404, invalid id → 400, catalog integrity (10 protected real-product slugs still present). Frontend (Playwright, 1920 + 390): admin login → /admin, Products tab search/list with thumbnails + category + price, Add product opens editor modal, upload main image shows preview, Save creates & lists product, Edit price (3.5→9.99 EUR) and long description persist via backend GET, Delete removes row and backend returns 404, Orders tab renders 'No orders yet.' empty state, mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow on products tab or editor modal, Save button reachable. No blocking console errors.

issues: Prices are shown in INR (₹, ~90x multiplier) by default even though admin inputs EUR in the editor and the stored price_eur matches input exactly. This is correct per the existing i18n currency formatter (langage default) but may be surprising for an EU admin. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin router gating is consistent: 401 for anonymous and 403 for authenticated non-admin tokens across POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/products and POST /api/admin/upload — matches require_admin dependency.
doc_to_product correctly strips ObjectId '_id' and returns id as string in create/replace responses. No raw _id leaked.

POST /api/admin/upload enforces image mime whitelist (jpeg/png/webp/gif) + 8MB cap, stores under /app/backend/static/products and the file is served via /api/static mount with correct image/* content-type.
Slug collision in create falls back to '<slug>-<uuid4[:4]>' preventing duplicate-key errors on the products.slug unique index.
Admin.js uses window.confirm for destructive delete — functional, but a shadcn AlertDialog with data-testid would be more consistent with the rest of the design system (not a bug).
ProductEditor uploads main image sequentially per gallery file (no Promise.all); for many files it will serialize uploads. Acceptable for an MVP, but a parallelized Promise.all would be nicer.
seed_data_creation: All created products were prefixed 'QA_'. Playwright flow cleaned them up (delete at end + residual cleanup loop); pytest fixture also deletes created ids on teardown. Catalog integrity test asserts all 10 protected real-product slugs still exist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin CRUD + /api/admin/upload are live and verified. For UI edits, price_eur is stored as EUR but displayed to the English/Hindi admin as INR via the shared formatPrice (lang-based FX). To verify price updates in the admin list by UI alone, convert 1 EUR ≈ 90 INR or fetch GET /api/products/{slug} directly. Orders tab currently empty — PATCH status flow is logically covered by the backend test but requires a real order to test via UI.
